plainTranslation: Drive grinds against control. The Mars person feels slowed, judged, or thwarted; the Saturn person finds the other reckless. Real friction around effort, ambition, or sex. Failure mode: resentment and suppression, or one shutting the other down. Workable if both respect the tension; name the brake instead of fighting it in silence.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their limits and your drive grind against each other. You feel blocked, and they feel rushed. Agree on the pace out loud.
tension: At its worst, it's just a power struggle. They block. You push. They dig in. You get angry. Eventually, the relationship stops being about the original issue and becomes a fight over control. This is where the aspect can become exhausting. What could have been used to build something meaningful ends up consumed by the struggle itself.
advice: The useful distinction is discernment. Some limits are real. Some come from caution, uncertainty, or a desire to protect what matters. Some feedback helps you act with more strength. Some feedback reflects a different relationship to risk and timing. Learn the difference. Turn the no into a conversation when you can. Ask what the concern is protecting and what the action is trying to accomplish.
summaryShort: Their limits and your drive grind against each other.
